Title: Ammo cards on Zip gun. OK?

Messages.Author: Shane Smith
Messages.Body:
We had a disagreement over use of ammo cards on the zip gun card last
game session. One side said it can't be used since there is no equipment
symbol on the zip gun, while the other side said "the card says "Weapon,
Gun" so the ammo card works on it." Who is correct? A netrep response
on this one would be nice since the arguement was rather heated and a
definitave answer would settle it completely. Thanks for any help.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
sha...@bigdog.engr.arizona.edu (Shane Smith) writes:



From the Design Team (11/9/94):
>Zip Gun:
> Ammo cards just modify the strike, not the damage done to the wielder.

So they're under the impression that you can use ammo cards on a Zip Gun.
(Where on the ammo card does it say it must be used on equipment cards only?
I thought it said "Gun" not "Equipment".)

Messages.Author: Bob Ellison
Messages.Body:


I'm not a netrep; but I'll post and let the netrep clarify if necessary.

The Zip Gun is a gun and can use ammo. It acts as a piece of equipment
in all ways (including use of the Arms Dealer or Al's Army Apparatus,
use of Vast Wealth, and trading weapons among minions) except that a minion
does not take an "Equip" action to obtain it.

papillo the wholehearted
